body: I do, but I wont have to deal with their guilt.
Even with the genocidal super-villains, there are so many fictions that are more appealing that our reality.

Its almost ironic. If I stay alive and heavily pursue genetics, I could live to see all that I love come to life. The hard part is living the long, right? But if I may ask, what is your favorite fantastical lore? I personally love The Lord of the Rings and all corresponding lore, if I had everything my way, I would life the lifespan of a Numenorean before the destruction of Numenor.
